summary: In the Badlands, Lotwil Veriatus needs bracers from greater rock elementals to judge his shackles.

sections.title: Gauging the Shackles
sections.body:
Lotwil Veriatus needs one last part from the Badlands' elementals, after the stone slabs. Bracers of rock binding from greater rock elementals will help him judge the shackles under construction.

His scrying found a group southwest, near some ogres, if memory serves. He asks for five bracers so there will be spares, since Servo often misplaces reagents and research.

faq.q: Why does Lotwil need the bracers?
faq.answer: Bracers of rock binding will let Lotwil gauge the strength of his own shackles.

faq.q: Why does Lotwil ask for five bracers?
faq.answer: Lotwil asks for five bracers so there are extras, since Servo often misplaces reagents and research.

faq.q: Where are the greater rock elementals located?
faq.answer: Lotwil's scrying found a group southwest, near some ogres. The hills around Camp Cagg are home to the greater rock elementals.

faq.q: What becomes of the stone slabs collected earlier?
faq.answer: When the work here is done, Lucien will take the extra slabs back to Kharanos, where they could prove useful again.
